name: Zann Gill
abstract_title:
Co-bootstrapping the origins of life

Autonomy – Pattern Recognition (A-PR) Cycles
abstract: Theories about origins of life focus on replication, metabolism, and enclosure, assuming that first life was able to receive, interpret, and respond to signals in order to replicate, perform thermodynamic functions, and distinguish its self from other to remain alive. We start from three key problems for origins of life theorists: 1) lack of an agreed definition of life; 2) combinatorial improbability of non-life becoming alive; and 3) the three-pronged debate about alternative hypotheses about
authors: Zann Gill, Tomas Veloz Gonzalez, Michael Levin
notable: NASA Incentive Award; developed A-PR bootstrapping hypothesis
notes: Former Research Scientist at RIACS contracted to NASA.
